items.stem: Describe the steps involved in the extraction of a metal of medium reactivity, such as zinc, from its sulphide and carbonate ores. Write equations. How is the metal refined?

Electrolytic refining: impure metal anode, pure metal cathode, solution of its salt as electrolyte; pure metal deposits on the cathode, impurities form anode mud.
items.markingKey: 1 mark concentration; 2 marks roasting/calcination; 1 mark reduction; 1 mark refining.

items.stem: Differentiate between aerobic and anaerobic respiration. Show the breakdown of glucose by different pathways with a flow chart. Explain the mechanism of breathing in humans.
items.answer: Aerobic: with oxygen, in mitochondria, CO₂ + water + much energy. Anaerobic: without oxygen, in cytoplasm, ethanol + CO₂ (yeast) or lactic acid (muscles), less energy. Glucose → pyruvate (cytoplasm) → ethanol + CO₂ (yeast) / lactic acid (muscle) / CO₂ + H₂O (mitochondria, with O₂). Breathing: diaphragm flattens and ribs lift, chest cavity enlarges, air is sucked in; reverse during exhalation.
items.markingKey: 2 marks differences; 2 marks flow chart; 1 mark mechanism.
